subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` expose existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside or rejected by the workspace fs-safe boundary?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes a shared operator-read Gateway response at a filesystem boundary, and accepting that behavior is a security/product decision rather than a routine bugfix detail.

options.title: Restore the fs-safe boundary
options.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and solve false Missing labels by filtering, neutral styling, or a typed external-file state that does not inspect outside-root paths.

options.title: Allow external metadata deliberately
options.body: Accept the exposure only with explicit security approval plus protocol/UI tests documenting what metadata outside-root transcript paths may reveal.

options.title: Split layout from backend semantics
options.body: Land or keep the already-merged layout fix path separately and resolve Missing-label semantics in the linked issue cluster.

recommendation.title: Restore the fs-safe boundary
recommendation.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and solve false Missing labels by filtering, neutral styling, or a typed external-file state that does not inspect outside-root paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace browsing work introduced the shared `workspace-fs.ts` boundary used by the current main implementation.
